title: Compact Attention: Exploiting Structured Spatio-Temporal Sparsity for Fast Video Generation

baseline_full_attention.description: Full attention computation in video diffusion transformers
baseline_full_attention.time_complexity: [N, N, d] where N = f×h×w (total tokens), d = hidden dimension

proposed_compact_attention.time_complexity: [N, N×s, d] where s = sparsity ratio

improved_method.description: Enhanced Compact Attention with adaptive thresholding and dynamic patterns
improved_method.time_complexity: [N, N×s(t), d] where s(t) = dynamic sparsity ratio based on timestep

gaps_limitations.description: Static threshold parameters (τ, λ) across all denoising steps
gaps_limitations.impact: May compromise quality in early denoising steps or miss optimization opportunities in later steps
gaps_limitations.current_approach: Fixed τ=0.9, λ=0.011/0.04 for all timesteps

gaps_limitations.impact: May miss complex spatio-temporal interactions in diverse video content
Cannot leverage multi-GPU systems for further acceleration
Same sparsity pattern applied regardless of video content complexity
Fixed frame grouping may not capture optimal temporal dependencies

proposed_improvements.name: Adaptive Threshold Scheduling
proposed_improvements.description: Dynamic adjustment of τ and λ based on denoising timestep and noise level
proposed_improvements.runtime_change: From [N, N×s, d] to [N, N×s(t), d] where s(t) varies by timestep

proposed_improvements.name: Content-Adaptive Pattern Detection
proposed_improvements.description: Use lightweight CNN to analyze video content and adjust sparsity patterns

implementation.pattern_selector: Dynamic pattern selection based on complexity

proposed_improvements.runtime_change: Minimal overhead: [N, N×s(c), d] + [batch, 224, 224, 3] CNN cost

proposed_improvements.name: Multi-GPU Distributed Sparsity
proposed_improvements.description: Distribute attention computation across GPUs with optimized sparsity partitioning

implementation.communication: Efficient attention weight sharing between GPUs

proposed_improvements.runtime_change: [N/k, N/k, d] + communication overhead where k = number of GPUs

proposed_improvements.name: Learned Pattern Primitives
proposed_improvements.description: Neural network to learn optimal pattern primitives beyond hand-crafted ones

implementation.pattern_generator: Small transformer to generate custom attention masks

proposed_improvements.runtime_change: [N, N×s_learned, d] + [N, N, d_model] pattern generation cost

proposed_improvements.name: Hierarchical Temporal Grouping
proposed_improvements.description: Multi-level temporal grouping based on motion analysis and scene transitions

implementation.adaptive_grouping: Dynamic group size based on content

proposed_improvements.expected_improvement: 10-15% better temporal coherence with same sparsity
proposed_improvements.runtime_change: [N, N×s_hierarchical, d] + optical flow computation [f-1, h, w, 2]

innovative_extensions.name: Real-time Streaming Compact Attention
innovative_extensions.description: Extension for real-time video generation with streaming input

implementation.sliding_window: Dynamic window adjustment for streaming data
implementation.incremental_update: Efficient mask updates as new frames arrive

innovative_extensions.runtime_change: [window_size, window_size, d] per frame instead of full sequence

innovative_extensions.name: Cross-Modal Compact Attention

implementation.modal_fusion: Joint sparsity patterns across text, video, audio

innovative_extensions.runtime_change: [N_total, N_total×s_cross, d] where N_total = N_text + N_video + N_audio

innovative_extensions.name: Adaptive Resolution Compact Attention
innovative_extensions.description: Dynamic resolution adjustment based on attention patterns

implementation.detail_adaptation: High resolution for detailed regions, low for others

innovative_extensions.runtime_change: [N_adaptive, N_adaptive×s_adaptive, d] where N_adaptive varies by resolution
